display_name: I Am Thief : Crime Simulator VR
display_long_description:
Step into I Am Thief: Crime Simulator VR, an immersive VR stealth game and VR simulator for Meta Quest where you sneak, steal, and escape across detailed virtual reality environments. Experience heist-style missions, interactive houses, and sandbox gameplay designed for smooth, action-packed VR simulation.

Core Gameplay

Master stealth mechanics by avoiding guards, cameras, and alarms while planning clean escapes. Use non-lethal tools and gadgets to distract AI, create openings, and complete objectives with precision in this engaging stealth simulator.

Features of I Am Thief:

• Heist Missions & Objectives – explore, collect valuables, and escape undetected
• Interactive Environments – open doors, search rooms, discover hidden routes
• Gadgets & Tools – smoke bombs, sound distractions, freeze-style tools (non-lethal)
• Police Chase Gameplay – evade pursuit and outsmart security systems
• Movement Freedom – climb buildings, navigate rooftops, and move silently
• Sandbox VR Experience – multiple approaches

Why Play

Designed for fans of VR games, stealth games, and simulator games, I Am Thief delivers immersive VR, realistic interactions, and engaging progression optimized for Meta Quest. Enjoy action VR gameplay, virtual reality adventure, and a stealth simulator that rewards strategy, timing, and exploration.

Enter I Am Thief: Crime Simulator VR and master one of the most engaging VR stealth simulator and VR adventure game experiences available.
